root_cause.summary: Normal delivery invoked unrelated cockpit/provider reconciliation work and legacy JSONB evidence could be reprocessed as strings, amplifying payload size and worker memory. The LinkedIn company lane then correctly stopped at a missing organization-scoped canonical OAuth connection.
technical: Social audit/cockpit work shared the publication critical path instead of an explicit mode.
Legacy delivery_evidence/generation_evidence values were not normalized to JSON objects before object spread/merge.
Repository source drifted from the production hotfix after the previous recovery PR closed without merge.

prevention_rule: Normal social delivery must call powerhouse-social-publisher in publish_only mode; cockpit_autopilot remains explicit and isolated.
All publication evidence reads must normalize legacy JSONB strings/arrays to bounded objects before merge or spread.
Applied production SQL must be mirrored under its exact production migration version in the canonical migration lane; never mutate the production ledger merely to fit Git.
LinkedIn company publication remains fail-closed until a canonical organization-scoped connection is objectively verified.

production_readback.linkedin_company_blocker: organization-scoped LinkedIn OAuth not available on any existing active connection
